rows.before: Imported TranslationBrowser.tsx + translation_snapshot_meta.json and rendered the search browser over a baked DB snapshot. Page title 'Translation Browser', lede about searching every EN line in the patch and submitting suggestions, meta line with dialog/items/NPCs counts + snapshot date, a 'Submission tips' details block, and a footer 'Open the JP↔EN ROM viewer →' link pointing to /translation/viewer/. Loaded the 11 MB translation_snapshot.json lazily from public/data/.
rows.after: Rewritten to render the in-browser JP↔EN ROM viewer that previously lived at /translation/viewer/. Imports TranslationViewer.tsx instead of TranslationBrowser.tsx. Page title 'Translation Viewer', lede explains the ROM-side parsing happens locally (no upload), meta line shows 'entire ROM' scope + 1,322 files + 83,979 Textblocks, 'How this works' details block explains the Load ROM flow / opcode tags / wildcard search. Breadcrumb is now 'Home › Translation' (the previous viewer.astro had 'Home › Translation › Viewer' since it sat one level deeper). Mounts <TranslationViewer ... client:only="react" /> with the public translation_en_lookup.json.
rows.reason: Tyler asked for the route swap: what's at /translation/viewer/ becomes /translation/, hide the old landing without deleting it.

rows.before: Astro page at route /translation/viewer/ that mounted TranslationViewer.tsx with breadcrumb 'Home › Translation › Viewer'.
rows.after: File deleted. The route /translation/viewer/ is now served via astro.config.mjs `redirects` as a redirect to /translation/, so external links and bookmarks to the old URL still land somewhere sensible.
rows.reason: Viewer content moved up one level into /translation/index.astro. Astro's redirect mechanism preserves the old URL without duplicating the page.

rows.after: New file. A verbatim copy of the pre-step-259 /translation/index.astro contents (the search-browser landing), placed under an underscore-prefixed parent directory so Astro does NOT build it into a public route. A leading comment block explains why the file exists, when it was hidden, and how to restore it if needed. The Layout / TranslationBrowser / translation_snapshot_meta imports are updated from '../../...' to '../../../...' to reflect the extra directory depth.
rows.reason: Tyler said 'hide, not delete' for the old landing. Underscore-prefixed paths inside src/pages/ are Astro's standard non-public convention.

rows.before: defineConfig({ site, base, integrations: [react()], build: { assets: '_astro' } }) with no `redirects` key.
rows.after: Same config plus a `redirects: { '/translation/viewer': '/translation/' }` entry, so visitors to /translation/viewer/ are bounced to the new canonical URL.
rows.reason: Preserve any external links / bookmarks / search-engine results that point at the old /translation/viewer/ URL. Astro normalizes the trailing slash, so a single entry covers both /translation/viewer and /translation/viewer/.
